title: Book Two · Chapter 125: Cold Hands, Warm Bread
story:
The last school week is cool and dry. Ronan takes his little place cards home in a paper folder. His name is on the back. There is no partner's name beside it.

At the gate, he sees the old correction notice. Miss Wu takes it down herself that afternoon. The term is ending. The materials room will have a new notice next term.

“Keep the right page with the school guides,” she tells him. “Next term, check the new notice before you give anyone a time.”

Ronan nods. He helps put the guides in their box. The box stays at school.

At home, Mum is rubbing her hands together. The sewing table is close to the window, and the air feels cold there.

“Bread first,” she says. “Then I can finish this sleeve.”

Ronan goes with her to the corner stall. Dad meets them on his way from work. He has a folded work sheet in his pocket.

Mum takes a warm packet from the seller. She gives Ronan the middle bun.

“The hottest one,” he says.

“You have the coldest hands.”

He holds the bun between both palms. Dad tries to reach for it.

“Mine are colder.”

Ronan pulls it away. “Your hands have pockets.”

“Unfair pockets.”

Mum laughs and gives Dad another bun. They stand out of the wind near the wall and eat.

Ronan tells them about his display. He explains the basket and the step. He says Mei showed him one edge with a ruler.

“And Jun?” Dad asks.

“He did another display.”

“With you?”

“No.”

Dad takes another small bite before he answers.

“What did you enjoy in yours?”

“The third story. The basket.”

Ronan shows its place with one hand. Mum watches from beside the warm packet.

“The one under the step?”

“Yes. I first looked beside the door too.”

He moves his finger lower.

“Then they could see it.”

Mum nods. She does not ask him to begin a new group with Jun. Dad asks about the first story instead.

Ronan tells them while they eat. He has things to say about his own page, even without another name on the folder.

When he stops for his bun, Dad looks down at his hands.

“Still cold?”

“Not now.”

The warm paper has gone soft at the edge. Ronan folds it back neatly so it will keep the rest of his bread.

Mum takes her own piece and looks along the street. They have stood here a little longer than they planned, with no one waiting for their next answer.

Dad nods. He does not ask Ronan to go back and try again.

At the green door, Mrs Lan needs room for a visitor's bags. Mum moves their empty basket from the path. Ronan takes his school folder indoors. He puts it on the shelf.

His three stories fit inside it. He opens the third card once more. The basket is still beneath the step. He can explain every arrow now.

Later, Dad asks him to help fold a clean cloth. They each hold two corners. Dad lifts his end too high, and the cloth rises between their faces.

“Where are you?” Ronan asks.

“Other side of the mountain.”

“Too much mountain.”

They lower it together. Mum reaches over and puts the folded cloth on her finished sleeve.

The room smells of warm bread and clean cloth. Ronan's hands are warm now. His display stays on the shelf for the holiday. He looks once more at his name on the folder. Then he sits beside Mum and finishes the last piece of bread.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

sleeve＝袖子；palm＝手掌；path＝通道；fold＝折叠。

## 理解问题

1. 谁决定取下旧通知？
2. Ronan能说明自己的展示了吗？他和Jun恢复搭档了吗？

## 读句子

**They / lower it / together.** 他们／一起／把它放低。
